text: _A. That, a notch on the field._

parsed.faithful: _A. That, a notch on the field._ Reft, a notch in the corner. A Flat, a notch on the fide. Sharp, a notch on the fide.
parsed.modern: A. That, a notch on the field. Rest, a notch in the corner. A Flat, a notch on the side. Sharp, a notch on the side.
